title: Associado de Comunidade
description:
Community Associate

Salvador, Alphaville

The world of work is changing…short commutes, flexibility, and convenience are the minimum standards employees want when it comes to how they want to work!

At IWG, we are leading the way. We’ve built the world’s largest workspace network so that our customers can work from wherever, and however they want…in over 120 countries across the globe!

Join us and help us bring more freedom to people and businesses, while expanding our network. You’ll be able to enjoy a great work life balance and competitive benefits, while growing your career path along the way.

The opportunity

As a Community Associate, you’ll work closely with new and existing customers across a myriad of industries, working to create and maintain your own community within your center, where you will help take care of all the administrative and support needs for your customers…so that your customers can focus on running their business.

A typical day at IWG

You arrive a few minutes before your center opens to make sure everything is ready and check there’s nothing the cleaners have missed.

Customers arrive all throughout the morning. One asks you for a changed WiFi code. Another wants to know if his important package has arrived. A woman needs directions to her meeting room… and can you help her set up the projector and show her where to find a great cup of coffee. You’re off to help her get set-up, as soon as you connect the incoming call to another customer. You may just ensure that all of the services are properly charged, so that invoices are accurate.

It’s time for a quick coffee break, relax and enjoy a few minutes to yourself.

The mail arrives. You sort through it while dealing with a whole host of other customer requests, remembering to email the customer from earlier to let him know his package is waiting for him in his mailbox. And that’s lunch.

A new wave of customers arrive throughout the afternoon. You help a customer with printing and another with their invoice. A customer in a team room says it’s too hot in their office, no problem you are on it and open a ticket in our service portal.

You’ve earned yourself another quick coffee break, relax and enjoy a few minutes to yourself.

Early afternoon, you sit down with the Community Manager to discuss the organization of next week’s networking event in your center. You plan and write the e‑invites to customers, then create, print and put up posters on the noticeboards around the center. To your excitement, the Community Manager is coming around the corner with a prospect (someone interested in joining the IWG community), you share a few details about what makes this space so amazing for your customers and encourage them to join the network soon so they can participate in next week’s networking event – then you head back to finish putting up your posters.

The day is coming to a close. Time to gently ask the large group in meeting room 3 to start wrapping up. You direct them to the nice restaurant you know around the corner, so they can grab a bite and continue their discussion. You ensure everything’s nice and tidy, it’s time to head home.

About you

We’re looking for someone who knows how to manage multiple tasks while providing customers with the best possible service. You also need to be:

  • A good communicator, with the ability to build strong professional relationships and empathize with people’s needs (Ideally 1+ years of customer service experience)
  • Happy taking ownership of problems and finding ways to solve them
  • Positive, enthusiastic, and able to adapt to fast‑changing situations
  • Experience and confidence using MS Office and other basic IT equipment
  • Legally eligible to work in the Country you are applying within and at least 18 years old
  • B1 or higher level of English communication skills

What we offer

On top of a competitive total compensation package, you’ll enjoy:

  • Work life balance (no standard nights/weekends)
  • Generous paid time off plans (sick and vacation)
  • Paid Company Holidays per calendar year (in addition to your PTO accrual)
  • A quarterly bonus plan program, with a competitive salary rate
  • A bright and inspiring work environment
  • Training and development opportunities aligned with great career path opportunities
  • A professional workplace community (business casual attire required)

description:
Descrição da vaga

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Auxiliar na implementação da metodologia de custeio por absorção, incluindo a definição e coleta dos direcionadores de custos (como volume de procedimentos, horas de utilização de recursos e alocação de rateios), além de executar as tarefas ligadas à metodologia, como validação de dados e ajustes periódicos.

Elaborar e manter controles de monitoramento dos custos por setor, por produção e por serviços.

Acompanhar indicadores econômico-assistenciais, incluindo custo por paciente, custo por setor, custo por procedimento.

Suportar auditorias internas e externas, apresentando evidências e justificativas das variações de custo.

Construir relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e análises críticas para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Atuar em parceria com áreas assistenciais, suprimentos, faturamento e contabilidade para obter informações e alinhar critérios de custeio.

Participar da revisão e otimização dos processos de custeio e do fluxo da prestação de contas.

Participar do ciclo orçamentário anual e mensal, consolidando dados, monitorando desvios (real vs. orçado) e propondo ações corretivas.

Apoiar a análise do impacto financeiro dos repasses médicos, verificando conformidade com contratos e identificando oportunidades de otimização.

Contribuir para estudos de viabilidade econômica de novos serviços, tecnologias ou expansões, incluindo propostas de precificação para procedimentos particulares.

Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados extraídos dos sistemas ERP, colaborando com as equipes de cadastro e parametrização.

Identificar desperdícios operacionais e propor melhorias em processos.

Cumprir o regulamento interno, os requisitos dos sistemas de gestão da qualidade, observação e cumprimento das regulamentações da ANS, bem como das normas e procedimentos de saúde, higiene e segurança do trabalho inerentes ao setor, a utilização de EPI's/ EPEC's (Equipamento de proteção individual/ Equipamento de proteção coletivo) quando a atividade assim o exigir.

Desenvolver outras atividades inerentes ao cargo ou a critério de seu superior imediato, desde que habilitado e estejam de acordo com o seu conhecimento e experiência.

Requisitos e qualificações

Possuir superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

Pós-graduação em Controladoria, Finanças ou Gestão Hospitalar é desejável.

Possuir experiência em análise de custos, orçamento ou controladoria, preferencialmente no setor hospitalar ou de saúde.

Domínio de Excel avançado (Power Query, Power Pivot), ferramentas de BI (Power BI ou Tableau) e sistemas ERP hospitalares (TASY, MV ou similares).

Conhecimento em contabilidade de custos hospitalares, tabelas de procedimentos (TUSS, CBHPM) e regras de repasse médico.

Familiaridade com legislação da saúde (ANS) e gestão de contratos.

description:
Requisitos

  • Formação; Curso: Auxiliar de enfermagem/Técnico de enfermagem
  • Registro em conselho ou certificações específicas (quando necessário);
  • Experiência. Será um diferencial

Atividades

  • Executar as atividades de processamento dos produtos de saúde atendendo as determinações do enfermeiro pleno cumprindo as exigências da RDC nº 15 de Março 2012.
  • Cumprir todos os preceitos éticos e dispositivos legais da profissão, respeitando ao código de ética de enfermagem, vigente pela RDC – Nº , a fim de manter a conduta profissional e prestar uma assistência livre de danos por negligência, imprudência ou imperícia.
  • Cumprir o Regimento Interno do Serviço de Enfermagem, e da empresa instituição/Hospital Aeroporto.
  • Executar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE), atendendo as etapas técnicas. do processo de cuidado ao paciente.
  • Preencher solicitações de troca, hora extra, remanejamento, comunicado interno (CI) e justificativas de ponto para que seja analisado pela chefia de imediato.
  • Cumprir os requisitos da Norma Regulamentadora de Segurança e Saúde no trabalho em serviço de saúde (NR 32).
  • Cumprir e executar as normas, rotinas, procedimentos Operacionais padrão (POP’s), protocolos assistenciais e administrativos do Serviço de Enfermagem, e da instituição/empresa Hospital Aeroporto em equidade de ações com qualidade e segurança na assistência ao paciente.
  • Cumprir a distribuição diária realizada pelo Enfermeiro pleno.
  • Cumprir toda e qualquer ação delegada pelo Enfermeiro pertinente ao cargo e dentro dos princípios legais da profissão.
  • Participar do dialogo diário de enfermagem e segurança (DDES).
  • Realizar leitura dos comunicados e orientações do livro de ocorrência.
  • Fazer o registro na ocorrência do período trabalhado, em livro próprio denominado “Livro de Registro de Ocorrência”.
  • Manter, corroborar com a organização do setor em sua totalidade.
  • Realizar, quando escalado, o Checklist de conferência de materiais e equipamentos do setor.
  • Identificar a validade dos produtos fracionáveis do setor através da conferência de datas de acordo com o protocolo de validade determinado pelo Serviço de Controle de infecção Hospitalar (SCIH).
  • Realizar troca das soluções diariamente ou sempre que necessário.
  • Ter conhecimento do manuseio de equipamentos específicos do setor tais como: Autoclaves (Esterilização a vapor); Statim (Esterilização a vapor rápido); Sterrad (Esterilização por Peróxido de Hidrogênio); Lavadora ultrassônica; Termodesinfectadora; Incubadora de teste biológico e químico, Pistolas de ar comprimido, aparelhos endoscópicos.
  • Retirar todo e qualquer material e equipamento com material biológico do setor para liberar para a higienização.
  • Realizar as etapas de limpeza e desinfecção, bem como da manutenção e do monitoramento dos equipamentos em uso na Central de materiais Esterilizados (CME).
  • Remover sujidade dos equipamentos expostos e das superfícies, levando em consideração as orientações da SCIH.
  • Realizar e registrar controle de carga das autoclaves.
  • Fechar as caixas de materiais perfuro cortante, quando estas atingirem seu limite.
  • No processo de expurgo, preparo, esterilização, armazenamento e distribuição: Receber ,conferir, desmontar, inspecionar, realizar lavagem manual ou automatizada, desinfetar, inspecionar novamente com lupa, preparar, esterilizar, conferir efetividade da esterilização, armazenar e distribuir os produtos de saúde das unidades.
  • Realizar os testes de monitorização de desinfecção térmica e esterilização dos produtos de saúde reprocessados.
  • Verificar e registrar em impresso próprio denominado “Controle de temperatura e umidade” a temperatura e Umidade do setor.
  • Atender os critérios de recebimento e utilização de materiais CONSIGNADOS, que não pertençam a instituição/empresa Hospital Aeroporto ( Recepcionar , conferir, limpar , inspecionar, preparar esterilizar e devolver).
  • Registrar os implantes utilizados em impressos próprios.
  • Checar previamente mapa cirúrgico para prever e prover a distribuição de recursos materiais instrumentais para atender aos procedimentos
  • Solicitar o serviço de higienização para limpeza concorrente ou terminal do setor.
  • Solicitar ao almoxarifado materiais administrativos e de uso diário.
  • Verificar e controlar as datas de validade, qualidade no armazenamento da embalagem, no arsenal dos produtos de saúde estéreis.
  • Participar das reuniões do setor seguindo o cronograma anual divulgado previamente pelo Enfermeiro.
  • Ser remanejado, quando necessário, e assumir a descrição de cargo pertinente ao cargo Auxiliar de enfermagem do setor destino.
  • Sinalizar através da planilha denominada “Escala anual de Férias”, a marcação dos meses de preferência para o gozo das férias.
  • Participar das atividades elaboradas pela Comissão Interna de Acidente CIPA, Comissão de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar CCIH, Serviço de Educação Continuada e demais comissões instituídas pela empresa/instituição Hospital Aeroporto.
  • Atender todas as solicitações ou convocações que forem solicitadas pelo Conselho Regional de Enfermagem BA “COREN”, através de ofícios recebidos.
  • Participar da educação permanente e treinamentos, através de aulas em auditório ou na unidade.
  • Participar das avaliações de desempenho realizada pelo enfermeiro líder, através do diálogo, seguindo itens do impresso denominado “Avaliação de desempenho”, e registrar no prontuário funcional suas pontuações acerca da avaliação.
  • Sinalizar, verbalmente, para o Enfermeiro qualquer não conformidade de materiais permanentes, descartáveis e equipamentos.
  • Cumprir os planos de contingências quando necessário, relacionados à modificação do padrão assistencial quer seja nos procedimentos ou na estrutura garantindo que não exista quebra de técnica nos processos realizados.
  • Receber e encaminhar materiais para serem esterilizados em empresa externa de esterilização.

Outras Informações

  • Local de trabalho; Hospital Aeroporto - BA
  • Escala de trabalho; 180 SN/SD - FLEXÍVEL
  • Disponibilidade para treinamento. Sempre que necessário

title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

description: Position Overview: As a Salesforce Administrator, you will play a foundational role in building and scaling our CRM ecosystem. Partners with Contact Center leadership to analyze operational bottlenecks and design scalable workflows that reduce agent handle time and improve customer experience. Supports and enhances CTI/telephony integrations and related automations, including screen pops, routing logic, call dispositions, and agent productivity tooling. Ensures secure, least‑privilege access by owning the configuration and governance of profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchies aligned with Contact Center needs. Identifies proactively opportunities to improve processes, workflows, routing, and system performance, particularly within the Contact Center environment. Manages data imports and updates, including deduplication, cleansing initiatives, and data governance enforcement. Supports integration efforts with core internal systems, marketing automation platforms, billing solutions, and internal tools. Delivers training, onboarding, and ongoing support to drive strong user adoption across fast‑scaling teams. Troubleshoots issues proactively and serves as the go‑to expert for Salesforce reliability, scalability, and performance. Position Requirements: 4 years of Salesforce Administration experience, ideally in an enterprise‑level or high‑velocity environment. Salesforce certifications, such as Administrator or Advanced Administrator, are preferred. Ability to work from our Austin-based headquarters, at least four days per week – excluding approved time off and business travel. Additional Requirements: Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration, automation (Flows), data modeling, and security architecture. Experience supporting Contact Center or Service Cloud environments, including agent workflows, case management, routing, or telephony integrations (preferred). Proven ability in requirements gathering, process design, workflow mapping, and reporting/analytics. Background supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or cross‑functional GTM operations. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn CRM data into insights and actionable recommendations. Familiarity with integrations, connected apps, APIs, middleware, and data sync patterns (no coding required, but technical comfort is essential). Hands‑on experience with lead routing, funnel analytics, lifecycle automation, or revenue operations tooling is highly valued. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a fast‑moving, high‑growth environment.

Possui um relacionamento de confiança com CFOs, CHROs e CEOs de médias e grandes empresas, especialmente as de Lucro Presumido ou Real? title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
About TurnkeyTurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! - Opportunity to attendprofessional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.- Private health insurance.- Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year- Fully Remote work;
- Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.- Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.- Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: Multidisciplinary Creative
description: Hey, Dingus! Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken English If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you. Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas. Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes). Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika’s values and employee experience across teams. title: Back End Developer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken) Please upload your CV Resume in English. Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,500 USD Along with our partner, we are seeking a strong Backend Engineer who thrives in fast-moving environments and has a specialty in all things data. They are at an inflection point. Their product is live and working, customers are telling them what they need, and the engineering team is building rapidly. You will work deep in complex backend systems and will be their go-to person for everything data-related: ingestion, modeling, pipelines, and the infrastructure that keeps it all running. This is not a data-first role that happens to touch the backend;
it is a backend role where data mastery is your distinguishing edge. What you'll do: Design, build, optimize and maintain scalable features and systems across our Python/Django backend Design and build robust data ingestion pipelines to onboard, normalize, and continuously update third-party data sources that power our platform Own data modeling and schema design across our platform, ensuring our data layer is structured for performance, flexibility, and long-term scale Implement asynchronous and distributed processing to handle large-scale operations reliably and efficiently Own data infrastructure tooling - including pipeline orchestration, storage, and warehousing - alongside application-layer development Contribute to new product capabilities and integrations, working closely with other developers, AI engineers and data scientists Collaborate directly with the CTO to define data strategy and technical architecture as the platform scales What you bring: 5+ years of experience delivering complex backend systems in production environments Strong proficiency in Python and Django (or a comparable framework) Demonstrated experience designing and building data ingestion pipelines and ETL workflows Deep understanding of data modeling and database schema design for both relational and non-relational systems Hands-on experience with data infrastructure tooling, including orchestration, storage, and warehousing Solid command of asynchronous programming and distributed systems concepts Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs Comfort operating in small, fast-moving teams with limited oversight Excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset Bonus points for: Familiarity with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes) Previous work supporting ML, AI, or agentic systems Experience with the Django REST framework Understanding of Terraform or cloud infrastructure as code Experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, or regulated data environments Benefits: A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance. The opportunity to join a fast-growing company at a pivotal stage, shaping scalable data-driven systems and architecture. Two weeks of paid vacation per year. 10 paid days for local holidays. *Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Global Networks Leader
description: Purpose As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services. Main Responsibilities Oversee the day-to-day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance. Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations. Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets. Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices. Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs). Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making. Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions. Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity. Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on network performance, issues, and improvements. title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Strong decision-making capability and accountability. Comfortable operating in ambiguous and high-pressure environments. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Ai Trainer
description:

simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.Links to more information on ProlificWebsiteYoutubePrivacy StatementBy submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote. Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets. Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job SummaryThe Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactivelyAssumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as requiredWork with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conductServe as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicatedParticipates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and ExperienceBachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).Experience managing clinical project team personnel.Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and AbilitiesStrong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.)..Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.Must have the ability to title: Especialista Em Infraestrutura Azure
description:

Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher - Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros - Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede Logs e análises - Integração com Log Analytics Workspace - Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL) - Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura - Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais ✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios - Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files - Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault - Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração - Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres - Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware) - Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade - Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos - Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde ✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade - Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas Automação e integração (desejável): - Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep - Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps - Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) - Runbooks operacionais padronizados ✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente - Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica - Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros ✅ Perfil de Experiência - Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure - Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes - Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica - Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure - Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente Contratação CLT Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas) O que oferecemos? Gympass;

title: Ibm Ess Storage Support Engineer

This includes monitoring, troubleshooting, break-fix support, routine health checks, and performance tuning of IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment. The role also requires participation in weekend on-call support for critical Severity 1 issues. Location: Brazil, Mexico Responsibilities: Provide day-to-day remote operational support for a 4.5 PB IBM ESS storage environment Monitor system health, alerts, capacity, and overall storage performance Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve storage-related incidents and service issues Provide break-fix support and coordinate escalations where required Support IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment Assist with tuning and troubleshooting of parallel filesystem workloads Carry out routine health checks and preventative maintenance activities Support SAN-related troubleshooting, including fabric connectivity and multipathing Participate in weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents only Maintain clear documentation of incidents, resolutions, and operational recommendations What we expect: Proven hands-on experience with IBM ESS storage systems Experience supporting IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in HPC environments Good understanding of parallel filesystem workloads and HPC job patterns Experience with SAN environments, including Brocade or Cisco fabrics, zoning, LUN masking, and multipathing Strong Linux administration skills, particularly RHEL and SUSE Working knowledge of the AIX command line Fluent English, both written and spoken Availability to work during EST business hours Ability to provide weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents Nice to have: Experience supporting petabyte-scale storage environments Background in data centre or scientific computing environments Experience with performance tuning of GPFS / Spectrum Scale Familiarity with supporting ageing infrastructure and maintaining operational stability Experience in incident management and root cause analysis We offer: Highly competitive compensation Flexible working hours Continuous education, mentoring, and professional development programs Strong management and tech expertise 12-month contract with possible extension

title: Fincrime Escalations Officer
description: About RevolutPeople deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.About the roleFinancial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence.Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.What you’ll be doing- Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases- Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements- Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs- Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review- Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases- Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity- Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times- Participating in projects with management as required- Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processesWhat you'll need- Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution- Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point- Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations- Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations- The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required- Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions- The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it- An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications- Fluency in English and PortugueseWe won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We're looking for full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineers with 7+ years of experience delivering production-ready software. The ideal candidates will have recent hands-on C# /.NET, modern JS framework (Vue.Js, React.Js, Angular), and extensive end-to-end API and integration experience. You should thrive in fast-moving environments and be able to quickly translate ambiguous goals into working features, rapidly master new tools, and own your code from design through post-release support. You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in. Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 restaurant locations use their technology today, and they process over $5 Billion of payments annually. Responsibilities: Perform full life-cycle commercial software development and maintenance, including analyzing specifications, documenting requirements, and architecting, designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions Collaborate with teams to design, develop, and produce high-quality code following best practices and standards for both new features and existing application maintenance Own features end-to-end - UI through API and Data layer too Support and refactor legacy code using modern methodologies and technologies Analyze code to identify defect root causes and provide resolutions Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies Address defects identified during various testing cycles Perform high-quality peer reviews Required Experience Excellent written and spoken English;
must be able to discusstrade-offs with teammates and stakeholders 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years Modern JavaScript framework experience (Vue.Js, React.Js, or Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts);
whatever it takes Must have\ "ownership mindset\" - you'llhave the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch Fluent in Git and modern branching / PR workflows Rapid learner, as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks Team first approach displaying transparency, reliability, decisiveness, and a laser focus on customer impact Rapid learner, as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks Desired Experience (Not Required) Daily use of Docker/containers (you wrote the Dockerfile) Azure PaaS (Container Apps, SQL, Cosmos DB, etc.) Track record of expanding scope of responsibility over time (e.G., owning more complex features, introducing new tooling) Obsession with metrics, logging, and user impact Additional Information Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork! Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big! Making mistakes is human, let's learn from them - be transparent! We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP About Velozient We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Analista De Política De Crédito Sr - Remoto
description: A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

title: Professor De Inglês Empresarial
description: Descrição da Empresa A COMUNIK IDIOMAS oferece treinamento empresarial e acadêmico online em diversos idiomas, como inglês, alemão, espanhol, francês e português, além de serviços de tradução. Também promovemos workshops corporativos voltados para apresentações, reuniões, negociações, viagens, conferências, elaboração de currículos e preparação para entrevistas e seleções de emprego e/ou acadêmicas como testes de proficiência. Nosso diferencial é a abordagem personalizada dos idiomas, com aulas de 60 minutos com professores exclusivos e o uso de plataformas online com conteúdos balizados internacionamente onde adaptamos o aprendizado às necessidades específicas do ambiente corporativo e/ou acadêmico de cada aluno. Descrição do Cargo: Se você é um professor curioso, dinâmico, que não se acomodou com a mesma metodologia há anos e busca inovar nas suas aulas, gosta de tecnologia, busca conteúdos atualizados na internet e usa IA de forma criativa, este anúncio é para você! Estamos contratando Professor (es) (as) de Inglês Empresarial para ministrar aulas de forma remota. Este cargo requer proficiência em inglês, a preparação e condução de aulas personalizadas de inglês, com foco em linguagem de negócios e necessidades corporativas específicas. O dia a dia inclui, além de metodologia CEFR a adaptação de materiais (realia), aplicação de avaliações e acompanhamento do progresso dos alunos. Este é um cargo contratado com flexibilidade para trabalhar de forma remota nos horários da manhã e após 17h00.QualificaçõesEnsino de inglês: Experiência em ensino da língua inglesa, com foco em conversação e aptidão para ministrar aulas eficazes e acessíveis a diferentes níveis de fluência.Inglês empresarial: Conhecimento específico em inglês voltado ao ambiente de negócios, incluindo terminologia, comunicação corporativa e habilidades práticas para reuniões e negociações.Comunicação e ensino: Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficiente, além de habilidades pedagógicas para envolver e motivar os alunos.Habilidades de TI: imprescindível o conhecimento de ferramentas como Google Meetings e Teams, Excel, Word, Power Point assim como o uso de AI para criação e adaptação de conteúdo.Importante: formação em letras e/ou certificações de proficiência na língua inglesa e experiência no ensino remoto e flexibilidade aliada à criatividade para atender a demandas personalizadas no ambiente corporativo.Diferencial: certificações no ensino de inglês como língua estrangeira (por exemplo, TEFL, CELTA).

title: Pessoa Arquiteta De Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas. Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência. O DESAFIO: Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;
● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;
● Definir e acompanharrotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);
● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;
● Desenvolver emanter padrões arquiteturais específicos para a BU (design patterns, governança, observabilidade, práticas de versionamento, guidelines de APIs);
● Elaborar e gerenciarartefatos de decisão técnica (ADRs, RFCs, RFPs), documentando mudanças estruturais e justificativas;
● Apoiar squadsna modelagem de domínios, integrações, definição de SLAs/SLIs/SLOs e desenho de fluxos críticos;
● Conduzir análises decapacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;
● Avaliar e introduzirtecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;
● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;
● Propor e desenvolverPoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;
● Colaborar comData & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;
● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);
● Trabalhar lado a lado com líderes técnicos, POs e engenharia para construir um backlog tecnicamente sustentável e evolutivo. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER: ● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável) ● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos ● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência Bancos de Dados e Persistência ● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos) ● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic) Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade ● Vivência com nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura cloud-ready ● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal)) ● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers Segurança e Compliance ● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS ● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia ● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial) Metodologias e Governança Técnica ● Vivência com Scrum/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, framework SAFe, SRE e práticas de engenharia moderna ● Governança de arquitetura, gestão de risco técnico e processos decisórios estruturados ● Documentação técnica: ADRs, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.Io Mentalidade e Comportamentos ● Visão sistêmica, pensamento crítico e capacidade de simplificar arquiteturas complexas ● Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.Js, Python, PHP, etc ● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto ● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica ● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos) ● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínua DIFERENCIAL: ● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos. O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ: ️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível) Assistência Médica

title: Pega Developer
description: We are hiring an experienced Pega Developer to drive digital transformation initiatives across public sector programs. This role sits at the core of mission-critical modernization efforts, combining deep technical expertise in Pega with system integration, workflow design, and scalable architecture. You will design and deliver secure, high-performance case management solutions that improve operational efficiency and service delivery for government agencies. You will transform complex business requirements into robust Pega applications — integrating enterprise systems, modernizing legacy environments, and ensuring compliance with public sector standards. This person acts as a key technical partner to Architects, Business Analysts, QA, and Delivery teams. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and implement applications using the Pega Platform Configure case types, workflows, user interfaces, data models, and business rules Develop and test integrations using REST and SOAP APIs with enterprise and legacy systems Collaborate with Architects, Business Analysts, and QA teams to ensure successful delivery Execute unit, system, and integration testing, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Participate in deployment planning, release management, and production support Ensure compliance with public sector security and accessibility standards Document technical specifications, configurations, and testing procedures Required Experience & Skills: 3+ years of experience in Pega application development Experience working across full SDLC implementations Strong knowledge of system integrations, APIs, and data management Familiarity with Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience) Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills Advanced English (written and spoken) Pega Certification (CSA, CSSA, or LSA) Nice to have: Experience with Federal or State/Local government projects Familiarity with security and compliance standards Why join Genesis Consulting: Work on high-impact digital transformation projects in the public sector Be part of a collaborative, mission-driven team Opportunity for professional growth and development

title: Ai Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description: AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.G., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. You will be responsible for setting up the logic branches, slot filling, and task-oriented closed loops. Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Write and refine high-quality System Prompts to control AI behavior, persona, and task accuracy. Continuously optimize prompts based on real-world interaction data. System Integration & Debugging: Support the integration of AI Agents with client systems (CRM, Helpdesk, etc.) via APIs and Webhooks. Use basic coding (Python/JS) to handle data parsing and custom logic nodes. Local Scripting & Voice Strategy: Translate and adapt AI scripts to fit local linguistic nuances. Define voice strategies—including tone, speed, and emphasis, to ensure a natural, human-like voice experience. QA & Daily Operations: Monitor AI performance, identify\ "Bad Cases,\" and perform troubleshooting. Conduct pre-launch testing (UAT) to ensure the agent meets quality standards before deployment. Global Collaboration: Communicate with international clients and cross-functional teams (R&D, Sales) to deconstruct requirements and deliver localized solutions. AI Agent Builder Core Qualifications Language: Fluent in English (Spoken & Written). You can confidently lead technical meetings and write high-quality, professional prompts/documentation. Logical Thinking: Strong ability to deconstruct complex business needs into clear, step-by-step logic flows. Technical Foundation: Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data). Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering. Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.G., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Business Intelligence Developer (Remote)
description: A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados. A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais, por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação). O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala. Responsabilidades Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS). Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT). Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções. Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes. Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes). Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível. Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados. Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados. Requisitos Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados. Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures). Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis). Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault). Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar). Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT. Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais. Diferenciais Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados. Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake). Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS). Experiência com versionamento de código (Git). Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados. O que oferecemos Trabalho 100% remoto. Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva. Flexibilidade de horário. Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados. Programa de capacitação continuada. Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: About the Company Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights. You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making. Responsibilities Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively Requirements Strong SQL skills Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics Comfortable working in a remote environment Able to pass a background check Preferred Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data Experience with BI and visualization tools Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment Experience with AWS-based data environments Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts How to Apply Please send your resume in English.

title: Senior Video Editor
description: Vacancy: Video Editor ❗How to apply Please make sure to complete the form and apply for this position using the Easy Apply button on LinkedIn as well - otherwise, your application will not be considered. About Us: Prime Insights is a Sweden-based technology company reaching millions of diverse users through our proprietary Market Research Panel. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: This would be a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 16k-22k BRL/mo. title: Business Intelligence Developer (Remote)
description: A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados. A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais, por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação). O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala. Responsabilidades Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS). Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT). Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções. Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes. Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes). Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível. Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados. Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados. Requisitos Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados. Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures). Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis). Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault). Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar). Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT. Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais. Diferenciais Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados. Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake). Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS). Experiência com versionamento de código (Git). Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados. O que oferecemos Trabalho 100% remoto. Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva. Flexibilidade de horário. Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados. Programa de capacitação continuada. Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.
